title: Let yourself be kept like a child
summary: This meets the moment when the heart has no sturdy voice left. The line lets helplessness become trust by receiving the Guru as mother and father.
takeaway: Let helplessness lean into the Guru.
lifeApplication: At the bedside, doorway, or parked car, soften the throat and say the line like a child asking to be held. Stop rehearsing strength for one honest breath.

source.shortMeaning: The heart blossoms when it lets the Guru become its shelter.
source.lifeApplication: When you feel small, ask to be held before you try to harden again.

evidence.coreClaim: The heart blossoms when it lets the Guru become its shelter.
evidence.turn: Longing ripens when saintly company shows the way.
